 2026 Allstate Big Ten Volleyball Tournament Clinch Update
 Story Links
 ROSEMONT, Ill. –  With one regular-season match remaining for each team, 14-of-15 berths in the inaugural Allstate Big Ten Volleyball Tournament have been clinched.   All 18 Big Ten teams are in action Tuesday to close out the regular-season, before tournament play begins Friday.
 Illinois, Indiana, Michigan, Michigan State, Minnesota, Nebraska, Oregon, Penn State, Purdue, Rutgers, UCLA, USC, Washington and Wisconsin have secured berths in the tournament 
 Nebraska has clinched the No. 1 seed in the bracket
 Oregon, Penn State and Wisconsin have clinched byes into Sunday’s quarterfinals
 Maryland will clinch a tournament berth with a win over Ohio State on Tuesday night 
 Maryland at Ohio State: Tuesday, Nov. 17, 7 p.m. ET (B1G+) 
 Ohio State will clinch a tournament berth with a win over Maryland on Tuesday night 
 Ohio State vs. Maryland: Tuesday, Nov. 17, 7 p.m. ET (B1G+) 
 * All scenarios listed above are contingent upon all scheduled matches being completed 
 The inaugural 2026 Allstate Big Ten Volleyball Tournament begins with three matches on Friday, Nov. 20, at Fishers Events Center in Fishers, Indiana, and will crown a champion on Wednesday, Nov. 25. The championship match will begin at 8 p.m. ET/7 p.m. CT/5 p.m. PT and be broadcast on FOX.
